title: The actual coefficient arrow between base-changed Picard direct images
statement: Let f:X->S, f':X'->S, u:X'->X with u;f=f', let L be a module on X, and let k:W->S. Construct an actual arrow R(f_W)_*(L_W[0])->R(f'_W)_*((u^*L)_W[0]). It is induced by the derived coefficient pullback unit and canonical direct-image composition, with the coefficients identified by the two projection equations of the pullback of u. This construction needs derived categories on all schemes but no flatness, properness, invertibility, cohomology, or affine model. The two projection equations are also proved in this module.

source.document: Stacks Project; Mathlib and the existing Lean library

proof.text: Pull back the morphism u in the over category and prove its source and base projection equations. Identify ordinary pullback of L_W with (u^*L)_W using ordinary pullback composition and the canonical tensor/ordinary adjoint-uniqueness isomorphisms. Use exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction, pinned by its sectionwise unit formula, for the same adjunction-preserving comparisons as canonicalSinglePullbackMap; a bare unnormalized adjunction choice is not used.

Compose the canonical single pullback map with the coefficient isomorphism. Apply relativeMVUnit along the base-changed u, then direct image of that coefficient map, and finally transport the composite projection to f prime over W. Every datum is an explicit construction from proved APIs or a canonical derived universal property.

lean.statement: def picardDerivedCoefficientMap {X X' S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S) (u : X' ⟶ X) (hu : u ≫ f = f') (L : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) : (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L)) ⟶ (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f' k)).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f' k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f' k)).obj ((Modules.tensorPullback u).obj L)))
